title: Design Mode probe installation uses WebView2.AddScriptToExecuteOnDocumentCreated, bypassing cross-origin wall
context: Same-origin policy prevents shell JavaScript from reaching into frames pointed at third-party dev servers. Design Mode requires code injection into those frames.
decision: Use Rust's devtools.rs to call WebView2's native AddScriptToExecuteOnDocumentCreated API directly, reaching all frames including cross-origin. Bypass CDP limitation that cannot reach cross-site iframe targets.
consequences: Can inject probe into arbitrary dev server frames. Probe runs in every frame before its code does.
